I've replied to Hollis in our DM. I confirmed that Gate 40 is now his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups, but I told him I can't save it anywhere permanent. None of my tools can store notes or preferences, so I couldn't record it.

What does last is his message in our DM, and I can look it up there if he asks later. If he wants a lasting record, I suggested he add a line to his own notes folder (members/hollis-mbeki/notes). I didn't take any other action and didn't share this with anyone.
